hero.description: From the first walk through your yard to the final plant going in, here's exactly how we take your space from plain to something worth stepping outside for.

workingProcessPage.quote: A garden doesn't grow overnight, and neither does a good process. Every step we take is slow on purpose, because the ones done right are the ones that last.

steps.title: First Conversation, Real Understanding
steps.description: Every project starts with a real conversation, not a sales pitch. We visit your site, check the soil, measure the space, and ask how you actually want to use it. We note sunlight, drainage, and existing greenery, so our recommendations are grounded in your reality, not a generic template. This step sets the foundation for everything that follows, and we never skip it.

steps.title: Concept, Plants & Honest Costing
steps.description: Once we understand your space, we put together a concept that fits it, with plant choices suited to the climate, a layout that makes sense for daily life, and a clear cost breakdown with no hidden surprises. You will see sketches, material options, and a realistic timeline before anything is approved, so you always know what you are signing up for from the very start.

steps.title: Hands-On Building, Start To Finish
steps.description: Our own crew handles the work from start to finish, no outside subcontractors are passed between jobs. We prep the ground, install irrigation where needed, lay hardscaping, and plant everything by hand with care. You will get regular updates as work progresses, and we stick to the agreed schedule closely, keeping disruption to your daily routine to a minimum.

steps.title: Support That Doesn't End At Handover
steps.description: A garden does not stop needing attention once it is planted. We check in after handover, offer maintenance plans for pruning, feeding, and seasonal upkeep, and stand behind our plant choices with a genuine guarantee. If something is not thriving the way it should, we come back and fix it, because a garden that struggles after we leave is not a job we consider finished.

hero.title: Privacy Policy
hero.description: A clear look at how your information is gathered, used, and protected when you buy plants or book a landscaping project with us.

privacyPage.intro: Taking care of your privacy is part of how we do business, just like caring for the plants we grow. This page walks you through what we collect on mahrajlandscaping.com, the reasons behind it, and the steps we take to keep it protected while you browse our shop, place an order, or request a landscaping service.

sections.title: 1. About Mahraj Landscaping
paragraphs: We're a Riyadh based nursery and landscaping company, offering indoor and outdoor plants, trees, garden supplies, and complete landscaping solutions.
lines: Nursery: Heet, Old Al Kharj Road, Riyadh, KSA

sections.title: 2. What Information We Gather
paragraphs: We keep this simple and only ask for what actually helps us serve you:
bullets: What you tell us directly: Your name, contact number, email, project or delivery address, and any message you send us through the website, a phone call, or WhatsApp.
Order and project information: The plants or services you request, garden preferences, appointment details, and payment records tied to your purchase.
General site activity: Technical details like your device, browser, and the pages you visit, mostly gathered through cookies to help us understand how the site is used.

sections.title: 3. Why We Collect It
paragraphs: Your information helps us to:
bullets: Answer your questions and give plant or landscaping recommendations
Handle orders, deliveries, installations, and ongoing garden care
Confirm bookings, send invoices, and share service updates
Make our website and services better over time
Send occasional tips or offers, but only if you've agreed to receive them
Stay compliant with the law and keep both our customers and business protected

sections.title: 4. Cookies On Our Site
paragraphs: Cookies help our website remember your settings and understand visitor patterns so we can keep improving. You're free to turn cookies off through your browser at any time, just know that a few features might not run as smoothly without them.

sections.title: 5. Who We Share Information With
paragraphs: Your personal details are never sold. We only pass them along when it's genuinely necessary, such as with:
bullets: Partners who support payments, deliveries, hosting, or technical operations
Authorities or professionals, if legally required
Team members directly involved in completing your order or project

sections.title: 6. How Long We Hold On To It
paragraphs: We hold your information only for as long as it's genuinely useful, whether that's completing your order, keeping records, meeting legal obligations, or resolving a question. Once it's no longer needed, we remove or anonymize it wherever we reasonably can.

sections.title: 7. Protecting Your Information
paragraphs: We take reasonable precautions to keep your data safe from misuse or unauthorized access. That said, no online system is completely foolproof, so we recommend sharing only what's necessary and letting us know right away if something seems off.

sections.title: 8. Your Rights & Choices
paragraphs: Depending on the law that applies to you, you may be able to request access to, updates on, or deletion of your personal data or opt out of promotional messages. Just reach out on WhatsApp or email us at landscape@mahraj.com to get started.

sections.title: 9. Links To Other Sites
paragraphs: You may come across links to WhatsApp, our social pages, or other outside platforms on our site. Once you leave our site, their own privacy rules apply, so it's worth checking those before sharing any personal details.

sections.title: 10. Privacy for Children
paragraphs: Our website and services are built for adults and business clients. We don't intentionally gather information from children. If you think a child has shared personal details with us, please let us know, and we'll remove it right away.

sections.title: 11. Changes To This Policy
paragraphs: This policy may be updated occasionally as our business grows. Whenever that happens, the newest version will be posted here, along with an updated "Last updated" date.

sections.title: 12. Get In Touch
paragraphs: Have a question about how we handle your privacy? We're always happy to help, just reach out anytime.
lines: Nursery: Heet, Old Al Kharj Road, Riyadh, KSA

hero.title: Terms & Conditions
hero.description: The simple rules for browsing our site, ordering plants, and working with us on your landscaping project.

termsPage.intro: Thanks for stopping by Mahraj Landscaping. Before you order plants, book a service, or explore mahrajlandscaping.com, here's what you're agreeing to. Using our site or hiring our team means you're on board with the points below.

sections.title: 1. Who's Behind This Site
paragraphs: We run a nursery and landscaping business out of Riyadh, offering everything from potted plants and trees to full garden design, irrigation, and upkeep.
lines: Nursery: Heet, Old Al Kharj Road, Riyadh, KSA

sections.title: 2. Browsing Our Site
paragraphs: Feel free to explore, just keep it lawful and respectful. Don't try to break, exploit, or hack into any part of our website or systems. We may tweak or refresh the content here whenever needed, without prior notice.

sections.title: 3. About Our Plants & Services
paragraphs: Photos give you a general idea, but plants are living things, so slight differences in size, shape, or color are completely normal and not a flaw.
Landscaping quotes are built around your specific site and goals, and the final scope gets locked in once we send a written quote or agreement.
We reserve the right to adjust, pause, or retire any product or service package as our offerings evolve.

sections.title: 4. Orders, Pricing & Payment
paragraphs: Placing an order or accepting a quote is a request on your end, and it's only confirmed once we accept it and stock or scheduling allows.
The price you pay is whatever's shown or quoted when we confirm your order, unless we've agreed otherwise in writing beforehand.
Payment terms will always be clear, whether at checkout, on your invoice, or spelled out in your service agreement.
Larger landscaping jobs may need a deposit or payments split across stages before or during the work.

sections.title: 5. Getting Plants To You & On-Site Work
paragraphs: Any delivery or installation date we mention is a rough estimate unless we've confirmed it in writing.
To keep things moving smoothly, please make sure our team has clear access, somewhere to park, and any permissions needed to work safely on your property.
Things like weather, blocked access, delayed supplies, or other events outside our control can shift the timeline, and we'll keep you posted if that happens.

sections.title: 6. If Plans Change Or You Need To Cancel
paragraphs: The sooner you tell us about a cancellation or change, the easier it is to sort out. Some fees may apply if plants have already been set aside, materials have been bought, or work has already started. Custom landscaping that's already finished usually can't be refunded, except where the law says otherwise.

sections.title: 7. Plant Health & What's Covered
paragraphs: We do our best to hand over healthy, well-cared-for plants. If we offer any kind of guarantee, we'll explain exactly what it covers at the time of purchase or in your agreement, and it usually assumes you're watering and caring for the plant properly.
Guarantees generally won't cover things like neglect, poor watering habits, pests that show up after delivery, extreme weather, or changes made by someone else after we've handed the plant over.
If something arrives damaged or looking unwell, reach out right away so we can sort out a fair fix.

sections.title: 8. Our Content & Branding
paragraphs: Everything you see on our site, text, photos, logos, and design, belongs to Mahraj Landscaping or the people we've licensed it from. Please don't copy, reuse, or repost any of it without asking us first.

sections.title: 9. Where Our Responsibility Ends
paragraphs: As far as the law allows, we're not liable for indirect or knock-on losses tied to our products or services. If something does go wrong with a specific order or job, our responsibility is capped at whatever you paid for that particular item or service.

sections.title: 10. Your Privacy
paragraphs: Curious how we handle your personal information? That's covered separately in our Privacy Policy.

sections.title: 11. Which Laws Apply
paragraphs: These terms follow the laws of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and any disputes go through the relevant courts in Riyadh, unless local law says otherwise applies.

sections.title: 12. When These Terms Change
paragraphs: We may revise these terms from time to time as things evolve. Whenever we do, the newest version will be right here on this page. If you keep using our site or services after an update, that means you're okay with the changes.

sections.title: 13. Reach Out Anytime
paragraphs: Got a question about anything in these terms? We're glad to walk you through it. Just get in touch whenever works for you.
